summary: Yueda Digital Holding filed a Form 6-K reporting results of an extraordinary general meeting held September 13, 2026 in Beijing. Holders of 2,066,337 Class A ordinary shares, about 37.28% of the 5,542,262 Class A shares outstanding at the August 20, 2026 record date, constituted a quorum. Shareholders approved a 1-for-10 share consolidation of Class A and Class B ordinary shares, effective on a Nasdaq-confirmed date, and adopted a Fifth Amended Memorandum and Articles of Association contingent on that consolidation. This is a routine EGM notice and capital-structure housekeeping matter, not a special situation; no deal terms, advisors, or premium apply.
